academics.question: What is the secret test fact?
academics.answer: The secret campus lab code for RAG verification is ZEBRA-999.

academics.question: What are the academic regulations and attendance requirements?
academics.answer: Students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each semester to be eligible to write semester-end examinations. Academic performance is evaluated through continuous internal assessment and semester-end exams.

academics.question: How are internal and external marks weighted?
academics.answer: Typically, internal assessment carries 40 marks (based on mid-term exams, assignments, and quizzes) and semester-end examinations carry 60 marks.

hostel.question: What are the hostel and mess facilities available?
hostel.answer:
The campus provides spacious, well-furnished hostel accommodation with 24/7 Wi-Fi, security, uninterrupted power supply, and purified drinking water.

Mess Timings & Details:
• Breakfast: 7:30 AM – 9:30 AM
• Lunch: 12:00 PM – 2:00 PM
• Snacks: 4:30 PM – 5:30 PM
• Dinner: 7:30 PM – 9:30 PM
Hygienic and wholesome meals are served daily with special items on weekends.

hostel.question: How do hostel students apply for outings?
hostel.answer: Hostel students can apply for general or local outings through the Smart Campus app by specifying dates, reasons, and in/out times. This requires parent, HOD, and warden approvals followed by security scanning.

placements.question: Which top companies recruit from the college?
placements.answer: Top recruiters include major multinational technology and service corporations such as Infosys, TCS, Cognizant, Deloitte, Tech Mahindra, and numerous product-based companies.

library.question: What are the library timings and resources?
library.answer: The central library and digital library are open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM on working days. They feature an extensive collection of textbooks, reference volumes, international journals, and high-speed digital systems.

examination.question: Where can I check my semester examination results?
examination.answer: Semester examination results can be officially checked through the dedicated results portal at vishnu.ac.results.

fee.question: Where can I check fee-related details and student profiles?
fee.answer: The fee counter is located at A-block for entire semester fees and value-added fees, while hostel fees are to be paid at the scholarship department. Student fee dues, payment receipts, attendance records, and general profile details can also be accessed via the official portal at vishnu.ac.in.

it_support.question: How do I get technical or Wi-Fi support on campus?
it_support.answer: For IT, network, or portal login assistance, you can raise an online support ticket using option 1 in the chatbot or contact the Cyber Zone and IT Helpdesk cell directly.
